aggregation_in_figure: None; one checkpoint and one fixed CLIP model
bge_preprocessing: Lowercase; replace punctuation ([.!"()*#:;~]) with spaces; collapse repeated whitespace; strip; tokenizer padding and truncation; unnormalized BGE-large-en-v1.5 CLS features before the adapter
clip: Fixed CLIP ViT-B/32, standard preprocessing and tokenizer, raw recovered class strings
data_access: Original medical images, image embeddings and private path mapping are not redistributed; exact pixel-level evaluation requires authorized source images and the original private mapping
dino_preprocessing: Bicubic resize shortest edge to 224; center crop 224; ImageNet normalization; unnormalized frozen DINOv2 ViT-g/14 features before the adapter
displayed_model: One COCO-trained RP+ES checkpoint, training seed 0, selected epoch 202
historical_limit: The full aggregation linking the old five percentages to executions remains undocumented
inference: CPU fp32, eval mode, no test-time RP, mixing, dropout, fitting or prompt tuning
inference_audit: Fresh CLIP and adapter inference; audited DINOv2/BGE feature cache reused, not re-extracted in the fresh confirmation run
rule: Same fixed images and class candidates; first argmax of normalized image/class-text cosine
sample_ids: Dataset-local public IDs; no patient IDs, image paths or image-content hashes
scope: COCO 566K-pair adapters, not the main 3.5M-pair setting; convenience subsets, not official clinical benchmark or verified patient-level splits
selection: Illustrative checkpoint chosen after exploratory inspection of five checkpoints; not prespecified or an unbiased seed-average estimate
